description: Verify institution email ownership via OTP. Call once to send OTP, call again with OTP to complete verification.

main.description: Step 1: send OTP to institution email. Step 2: submit OTP to verify and create membership record.

did.description: DID of the user requesting verification.

otp.description: One-time password received via email. Omit on first call to trigger OTP send.

status.description: Current verification status after this call.

membershipUri.description: AT URI of the created membership record. Present only when status is verified.
